设计意图： Mutation of the qualified signed path-efficiency parent. The long-horizon signed efficiency remains the core economic mechanism and preserves the parent's positive cost-adjusted payoff and low-turnover profile. The recent confirmation window is extended to 63 bars and its absolute efficiency is averaged over three trailing observations, reducing sensitivity to isolated path-shape fluctuations and

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 net_move：close - close.shift(126)
  3. 计算 path_length：close.diff().abs().滚动窗口(126, min_periods=126).sum()
  4. 计算 efficiency：net_move / path_length
  5. 计算 recent_net_move：close - close.shift(63)
  6. 计算 recent_path_length：close.diff().abs().滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).sum()
  7. 计算 recent_efficiency：recent_net_move / recent_path_length
  8. 计算 confirmation：recent_efficiency.abs().滚动窗口(3, min_periods=3).mean()
  9. 计算 signal：efficiency * confirmation
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_signed_path_efficiency_cycle_smooth_confirm_63(df): """Measure persistent directional price movement with a smoothed recent path confirmation.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] net_move = close - close.shift(126) path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(126, min_periods=126).sum() efficiency = net_move / path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan) recent_net_move = close - close.shift(63) recent_path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(63, min_periods=63).sum() recent_efficiency = recent_net_move / recent_path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan) confirmation = recent_efficiency.abs().rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean() signal = efficiency * confirmation df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_cycle_smooth_confirm_63"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_cycle_smooth_confirm_63"]
